title: Kagamine Rin — Happy Anniversary! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Everybody! I wanna hear you get waaay louder!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len's half is coming up after mine is over... But no holding back, okay?! We want you to give 100% and enjoy them both to the fullest♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, my solo medley's gonna just keep coming!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks for bringing all the energy!
Hehehe, you guys made this super fun♪
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Great stuff, Rin! You were totally on fire!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your passionate voice filled every one of us with strength!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe, thanks! My medley went perfect♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, now that everyone's having a great time, let's move on to our next segment.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For this one, we all talked it over and came up with the perfect game for Rin to enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And of course, we're confident that all of you here to watch will enjoy it as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Without further ado, the name of this segment is... “Rin's Wish is Our Command! Let's Play Charades!”

rows.Speaker: Len & KAITO
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
The rules are simple.
First, Rin will decide on something to gesture and who she wants to gesture it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That person does the requested gesture, while the rest of us try to guess what Rin said.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll play three times! We win if we guess correctly at least twice, but if not, that's a win for Rin♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So Rin, try to come up with the hardest topics you can!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, I'm going all out here♪ I hope you'll all root for me!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And I'm already ready for round 1! I know what topic I'm giving... And Len, I'll have you gesture first!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, on it! So, what do I gesture...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: H-Huh?! How am I supposed to do that?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heh heh, good luck♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What could it be? I'm excited to see.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Umm...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: C'mon! Look!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And that's time!
The correct answer was “Len”!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ohh, so that's why he kept pointing at his face!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay, my plan worked♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Alright, now for round 2!
I think I'll have Miku gesture this time!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me? Okay, I'll do my best! What do I gesture...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, got it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh...?
Ah! Hehe, I know what Rin said.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It was “thank you”!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Correct!
Maybe that one was too easy?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But that one was a message from me to everybody watching today! Take it to heart, okay?♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That was a wonderful topic. Still... Will you be able to win now that we've guessed one correctly?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I won the first round, so I'm not worried!
Now, time for the last topic... Let's settle this fair and square! I've gotta come up with something totally impossible!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh man, I'm pumped! I'm guessing this no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, I'll ask Luka to gesture this one! I want you to gesture...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
And that's the end of the final round!
As for the results...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We guessed two out of three topics correctly, which means it's our win!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Man, I can't believe I lost!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Or more like, I had no idea Luka was that good at gestures!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Seriously! If it was me gesturing “one of those tiny segments you sometimes find in a mandarin”, I really don't think I could have pulled it off!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe, thank you.
I'm glad I gave it my all♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Aww, I should've made KAITO do the gesturing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But still, that was super fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Having everybody act out whatever I told them to made me feel like a princess!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, we're glad to hear it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But we'll have you know the celebration isn't over.
We've prepared a special message for you, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? A message for me?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's right! So, here it is! Listen up, okay?
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Rin.
I'm so glad to have this opportunity to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Every time I hear your cheerful voice, I feel myself start to smile. I hope I keep getting plenty of chances to listen!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know what he means. I end up smiling anytime we're together, whether we're singing or just chatting!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Let's keep doing both a whole lot!
I'll say it again, happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, I'd promised myself I'd do my best during the gesture game today, so I felt a little nervous when you called on me for the last round.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin, I love how bright and cheerful you are, and the way you can befriend anyone and everyone. I hope I can keep counting on your friendship from here on out. Have a wonderful anniversary.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Rin!
It makes me so happy when you come to me for help during singing or dance practice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I hope you'll keep leaning on me going forward too. I mean, I can do anything if it's to make you smile♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, Rin! Happy anniversary!
Man, it sucks being the only one who couldn't get everyone to guess what I was gesturing! But hey, that just shows my partner came up with a great topic!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm gonna keep working my hardest to impress you like that too, so make sure you keep up! Let's push further and further ahead, side by side!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You guys...!
Hehehe, thanks for the amazing message!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, you're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We got to share how we feel... But this venue is full of plenty more people who want to celebrate, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So now, let's get everyone in the audience today to join us in wishing Rin a happy anniversary! On three, are you ready?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Alright, here we go! One, two, three!
Happy anniversary, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks for all the anniversary wishes, everybody!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Len and everyone on stage, all of you in the audience, you gave me a whole lot of energy today!
Hehehe, I wanna play charades again sometime too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I promise to always sing my hardest and keep you coming back for more, so I hope you'll stick with me forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm so glad to see you this happy, Rin!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too! However... The show is far from over! We're all singing together next, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! Let's get this place really pumping!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Your wish is our command, Princess.
How was that?♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hahaha, this most pleases me!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright then, our next song is...this one!
